about: Intro walkthrough (spec v0.31 §6.5). Steps target data-tour attributes; a missing or hidden target shows a centred caption. Edit wording here; no code change needed.

steps.title: Welcome to Bible Zoom
steps.text: See the layers around the text: how it is written, the world it comes from, and how people read it. Let’s explore Genesis 1.

steps.title: Move around the Bible
steps.text: Choose a book, chapter and verse, or type a reference like “John 3:16”.

steps.title: Zoom in and out
steps.text: Go from the whole Bible down to single words. Section shows labelled bands; Sentence shows every word, with its Hebrew or Greek.

steps.title: Text size and Bible version
steps.text: Make the text larger or smaller here. Click the version, such as KJV, to switch to another Bible.

steps.title: Choose a view
steps.text: One tap shows a ready-made set of layers. Tick your own and choose “Save as my view…” to keep them.

steps.title: Or choose each layer
steps.text: Layers are grouped by question: how people read it, the world of the text, and how it’s written. Below the text are the original words and grammar. On a phone, open the panel with the Layers button.

steps.title: At a glance
steps.text: At Book and Chapter zoom, this card sums up the passage: its outline, people, places, themes, and where readers disagree.

steps.title: Several readings, side by side
steps.text: Where readers disagree, each row names its question ({sets}) and shows every reading in its own colour. None is ranked.

steps.title: Open any band
steps.text: A band opens to show what the layer means, each reading beside its colour, and who holds it. AI suggestions are always labelled.

steps.title: Highlight and add a note
steps.text: Click a word, then another, or drag. Type a note if you like, then tap a colour: one tap saves both. You can rename the colours. Highlights need a free account. The tour saves nothing.

steps.title: Ask AI about those words
steps.text: The sparkle button asks about the words you selected. Use your own ChatGPT or Claude, or a model on this device. Nothing is sent until you press a button.

steps.title: Keep, print and back up your notes
steps.text: My notes, in the account menu, gathers everything you write. Print it, save a PDF, or download a backup you can restore later.

steps.title: Share, and tell us what you think
steps.text: Share Bible Zoom or this passage from here. To report a problem or an idea, use Send feedback at the bottom of the page. Replay this tour any time from the ? button.
